sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
In Sweet Halloween, the core gameplay mechanics are simple yet addictive. The goal is to pop bubbles by matching three or more of the same color. Sounds easy, right? Well, it's not as simple as it sounds. With thousands of levels to play through, each with its own unique challenges and obstacles, you'll need to think carefully about your next move. One of the key mechanics in Sweet Halloween is the bubble swap system. By tapping on a bubble, you can change its color, which can be a lifesaver in certain situations. For example, if you're stuck with a bunch of red bubbles and there's a blue bubble on the board, you can swap the blue bubble with a red one to clear the level.

Another key mechanic in Sweet Halloween is the power-up system. As you play through the levels, you'll earn coins and stars that can be used to purchase power-ups and boosts. These power-ups can be used to clear the obstacles on your way, including bombs, fireballs, and more. With the right power-ups, you can clear a level in no time.

The game also features a variety of obstacles, including frozen bubbles, bubbles with shields, and bubbles that change color when popped. These obstacles add an extra layer of challenge to the game, requiring you to think carefully about your next move. Overall, the core gameplay mechanics in Sweet Halloween are simple yet addictive, making it a game that's perfect for players of all ages.
